userStories.title: Add paginate with keyset and offset modes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want one paginate stage so that no source re-implements pagination.
acceptanceCriteria: Add paginate to media/pipeline supporting both modes: keyset (raw-query hop via nextRaw), offset (in-memory slice of the sorted set) (design §C/§E)

userStories.notes: Created apps/server/src/media/pipeline/paginate.ts: the single paginate STAGE (design §C/§E) replacing the 3 forked paginators. Pure function `paginate({items, cursorMode, cursor, nextRaw, limit, log?}) -> {items, cursor}` (encoded next-page string). KEYSET mode: slice items to limit; next cursor = nextRaw===undefined ? null : encode({mode:keyset,k:nextRaw}). The SOURCE (US-014/015 fetchRawSet) owns the resume position — it threads the hop token into nextRaw and signals exhaustion (incl. #500 empty-streak give-up) by OMITTING nextRaw, so paginate emits cursor:null then (no phantom load-more, V.PG1/#500). OFFSET mode: start = incoming cursor.mode==='offset' ? cursor.n : 0; slice(start, start+limit); next = (start+page.length) < items.length ? encode({mode:offset,n}) : null. #501 preserved structurally: filter is now its own upstream pipeline stage over the FULL set, so paginate slices the whole filtered+sorted tail in one pass — no bounded overshoot window can strand sparse bucket+sort matches (verified by the home _shared.ts offset model: slice(off,off+size), hasMore = len > off+size). RISK-005 OFFSET_FULL_LOAD_WARN_ROWS=1000 (moved from watchlist listItemsOffset) advisory warn on the offset path; extracted to warnIfOverCeiling helper to keep paginateOffset under fallow's complexity threshold (cyclo 6->4; cursor.ts decode at cyclo 5 remains the only pre-existing complexity warn). Logger optional — missing log never throws.
